verdict.rationale: Unleash has a public GitHub repository (github.com/Unleash/unleash). The docs describe an 'Unleash Open Source' edition that you deploy by cloning that repository, and community members independently recommend it as an open-source, self-hosted LaunchDarkly alternative. missing for 10: the specific license (e.g., its name or terms) is never cited, and there is no evidence on whether Enterprise-only features are also source-available.
